modules.title: Test and debug
goals: Find and fix the bugs in a faulty BFS.
Choose test cases, such as a cycle or a disconnected graph, that expose a bug.

activities.title: Quick recall: when BFS finds a vertex

config.prompt: When does BFS count a neighbour as found, so that it never adds it to the queue twice?

options.label: Only when it leaves the queue

feedback.dequeue: Not quite. Until it leaves the queue, another vertex could find it again and add it a second time. Count it as found the moment it joins.
feedback.finish: Not quite. BFS needs to know what it has found while it is still running, or it adds vertices twice. Count it as found the moment it joins.

hints.body: Picture a vertex that two other vertices both have as a neighbour.
If BFS waited to count it, the second vertex could add it to the queue again.
Module 3: a vertex is found when it joins the queue, and visited when it leaves.
Answer: when it joins the queue.
